_comment: Frequency blocks a listener can assign to a dongle. One dongle covers one
block, and setup.sh offers these as the menu when a dongle is attached.
A block is one rtl_airband device: a single center frequency with all of
its channels demodulated from that one tuner. Channels are therefore
grouped by proximity -- every channel in a block must fall inside the
tuner's usable span around center_freq_mhz (max_span_mhz below).
To add a block: give it a unique id, serial and channel names, set
center_freq_mhz to the midpoint of its channels, and run
which checks the span, the uniqueness rules and the serial length.
serial is written to the dongle's EEPROM so rtl_airband can address that
physical device. Keep it short and unique across blocks.
PulseAudio sink names are derived as pv_<channel name>, so channel names
must be unique across every block, not just within one.
